services.faq1Q: How long does it take to build a website?
services.faq1A: A landing page takes about 1 week. A business website typically takes 2-4 weeks, and custom projects vary depending on complexity — usually 4-8 weeks.
services.faq2Q: How much does a website cost?
services.faq2A: Landing pages start at $150, business websites from $500, and custom builds from $1,500. Use the quote builder above for an instant estimate tailored to your needs.
services.faq3Q: Do you handle domain and hosting?
services.faq3A: Yes. I can register your domain name, set up SSL certificates, and manage hosting on reliable providers so you don't have to worry about the technical side.
services.faq4Q: Can you add a chatbot to my website?
services.faq4A: Absolutely. AI chatbot integration is available as an add-on for any website project — it provides 24/7 automated support for your visitors.
services.faq5A: Every website I build is mobile-first and responsive. It will look and work great on phones, tablets, and desktops.
services.faq6Q: What happens after my site launches?
services.faq6A: I offer ongoing maintenance plans starting at $150/month covering security updates, performance optimization, and content changes. You're never left on your own.
services.faq7Q: Can my website be in multiple languages?
services.faq7A: Yes. Multi-language support is available as an add-on. I can build your site in English, Turkish, Arabic, French, or any language your audience needs.
services.faq8A: Every website includes basic SEO setup — optimized structure, meta tags, fast loading, and sitemap. Advanced SEO optimization is also available as an add-on.
services.faq9Q: Do you build custom websites or use templates?
services.faq9A: Every website is custom-built from scratch using Next.js and React — no templates, no WordPress themes. You get a pixel-perfect site tailored to your brand and business goals, not a recycled design.
services.faq10Q: Will I own the website after launch?
services.faq10A: Yes, 100%. You own all the code, content, designs, and hosting accounts. I set everything up in your name and hand over full access. No vendor lock-in, ever.
services.faq11Q: How is Next.js different from WordPress?
services.faq11A: Next.js sites load in under 1 second vs 3-8 seconds for typical WordPress sites, have no plugin vulnerabilities, rank better on Google out of the box, and cost less to maintain long-term. Better performance, security, and SEO.
services.faq12Q: Do you work with clients outside Istanbul?
services.faq12A: Yes. I work remotely with clients worldwide — currently serving businesses in Turkey, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. All communication happens via email, WhatsApp, and video calls.
services.faq13A: Every package includes 2-3 rounds of revisions during the design phase. I also do unlimited minor tweaks until you're happy — I don't nickel-and-dime clients on small changes.
services.faq14Q: Can you build a website for my medical clinic?
services.faq14A: Yes, clinic websites are one of my specialties. I've built multilingual sites for aesthetic and medical clinics with appointment booking, before/after galleries, WhatsApp integration, and KVKK compliance. Perfect for attracting international patients.
services.faq15A: Most projects work with a 50% deposit to start and 50% on launch. For larger projects I offer 3-stage payment plans (discovery, design approval, launch). All fixed-price, no hidden fees.

clinicWebsites.heroSubtitle: Specialized Next.js websites for aesthetic, dental, and medical clinics in Istanbul. Multilingual, fast, and built to convert first-time visitors into consultation bookings.
clinicWebsites.heroCTA: Get a Free Clinic Website Audit
clinicWebsites.problemHeading: The problem most Istanbul clinics have online
clinicWebsites.problemText: Istanbul has 50+ JCI-accredited clinics competing for international patients. Most have slow, template-based WordPress sites that load in 5-8 seconds on mobile, don't speak Arabic or Russian properly, and bury the consultation CTA three scrolls deep. International patients — especially from the Middle East — judge a clinic's quality by its website in the first 3 seconds.
clinicWebsites.featuresSubtitle: Every clinic website ships with these as standard — not add-ons
clinicWebsites.feature1Desc: Proper hreflang, RTL Arabic support, locale-aware routing. Not machine translation — real structure for each language.
clinicWebsites.feature2Desc: Every treatment page has a one-tap WhatsApp button pre-filled with the treatment name. Your sales team picks up warm leads directly.
clinicWebsites.feature3Desc: Smooth booking flow for consultations, pre-assessments, and appointments. Integrates with your existing calendar or CRM.
clinicWebsites.feature4Desc: Lightbox galleries with privacy controls, proper lazy loading, and mobile-optimized swipe. The #1 trust signal for cosmetic patients.
clinicWebsites.feature5Desc: Schema.org Physician markup so Google can surface doctor info directly in rich results. Badges for JCI, ISO, and training certifications.
clinicWebsites.feature6Desc: Cookie consent, data handling, and contact forms built to Turkish and European medical data standards out of the box.
clinicWebsites.feature7Desc: Next.js SSR + image optimization + aggressive caching. Your site passes Core Web Vitals so Google ranks you higher in mobile search.
clinicWebsites.feature8Desc: Treatment pages structured around patient intent keywords. Ranks for 'rhinoplasty Istanbul', 'hair transplant cost Turkey', and more.
clinicWebsites.projectsSubtitle: Real case studies — see the full breakdown
clinicWebsites.process1Desc: We review your current site, target markets, treatment lineup, and competitors. Free 30-minute consultation.
clinicWebsites.process2Desc: Map out which treatments need which languages, plan doctor profiles, and structure your SEO keywords per locale.
clinicWebsites.process3Desc: Custom Next.js design (no templates), WhatsApp integration, booking system, and schema markup. Usually 4-6 weeks for a complete clinic site.
clinicWebsites.process4Desc: Submit to Google, set up analytics, train your team on content updates, and iterate based on real patient traffic.
clinicWebsites.faqSubtitle: Answers to the questions clinic owners ask most
clinicWebsites.faq1Q: How many languages can you support?
clinicWebsites.faq1A: Out of the box we support English, Turkish, Arabic, and French with proper hreflang and RTL for Arabic. Adding Russian, German, or any additional language is straightforward — we already have the multilingual architecture in place.
clinicWebsites.faq2A: Yes. Every clinic site we build includes KVKK-compliant cookie consent, data handling for contact forms, and privacy policy templates. This is essential for Turkish medical businesses and we treat it as a non-negotiable baseline.
clinicWebsites.faq3Q: Can you build an online consultation booking system?
clinicWebsites.faq3A: Yes. We can integrate with Cal.com, Calendly, or build a custom booking flow that saves to your existing CRM. The goal is zero friction between a visitor and a booked consultation.
clinicWebsites.faq4Q: How do you handle before/after photo galleries with privacy?
clinicWebsites.faq4A: Galleries include opt-in consent management, watermarking options, lazy loading so they don't slow the page, and blur/reveal interactions for sensitive content. We follow Turkish medical photo consent requirements.
clinicWebsites.faq5Q: How much does a clinic website cost?
clinicWebsites.faq5A: A complete clinic website with 2 languages, booking, WhatsApp integration, and SEO setup starts at $1,500. A fully-loaded site with 4 languages, AI chatbot, and custom CMS runs $3,000+. See the pricing page for the full breakdown.
clinicWebsites.faq6Q: How long does it take to launch?
clinicWebsites.faq6A: Typical clinic site launches in 4-6 weeks from kickoff. Complex multilingual builds with booking integration can take 8 weeks. We start showing you designs in week 1, so there are no surprises.
clinicWebsites.faq7Q: Do you integrate with the HealthTurkiye portal?
clinicWebsites.faq7A: Yes. If your clinic uses HealthTurkiye for patient onboarding or booking, we can integrate lead forms and consultation requests directly into their system.
clinicWebsites.faq8Q: Can I edit content myself after launch?
clinicWebsites.faq8A: Yes. Clinic sites come with a lightweight CMS so you can update treatment pages, prices, doctor bios, and blog posts without needing us. Complex changes — like new languages or new booking flows — come back to us.
clinicWebsites.faq9Q: Do you work with clinics outside Istanbul?
clinicWebsites.faq9A: Yes. We work remotely with clinics across Turkey and internationally. All communication happens via email, WhatsApp, and video calls — location has never been a blocker for us.
clinicWebsites.faq10Q: What if I need the site in a language you don't speak?
clinicWebsites.faq10A: No problem — we handle the technical setup (hreflang, URL structure, font support, RTL if needed) and you provide the translations (or we can recommend translators). The architecture supports any language you need.
clinicWebsites.ctaHeading: Ready to Turn Your Clinic Website Into a Lead Machine?
clinicWebsites.ctaSubtitle: Book a free 30-minute audit — we'll review your current site, identify the top 3 conversion blockers, and show you exactly how a multilingual Next.js rebuild would perform.
